seasons.name: Winter
seasons.label: Winter · Hokkaido
seasons.story: Calm, cold water. Heavy rod season; Tuna in demand. Fish keep to tidy lines and corners.

seasons.name: Monsoon
seasons.label: Monsoon · Bay of Bengal
seasons.story: Rough, dark water. Hunters come out: Barracuda ambush, Swordfish ricochet, Octopus hops along the edges.

seasons.name: Summer reef
seasons.label: Summer reef · Australia
seasons.story: Bright and lively. Fish come close to the seats: Turtle seat visits, Octopus rising under seats, Tuna swinging between corners.
